basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Deysarkar Centre of Petroleum and Energy Transition at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur needs one Project Research Assistant - Research for a 12-month sponsored project on a polymer-crosslinker-breaker system for high-temperature hydrofracturing, funded by SNF Flopam India Pvt. Ltd. The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 35,500 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The essential qualification is a BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree, or other combinations with experience. Applications are invited online, and the last date is 28 November

qualification.details: Knowledge of Computer applications, Secretarial experience for Technical and Ministerial. B.Tech in Petroleum Engineering is preferred, with CGPA>7.5. Experience in handling HTHP equipment and advanced Rheometer. Desired experience: minimum 2 years.

how_to_apply: Apply online before 28 November 2026; the notice invites applications through online mode.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

The application fee is Rs. 0 for every category. The notice says a fee, where deposited, goes to State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302, account name IIT SRIC-OM Account, account no. 39502115210, IFSC SBIN0000202, SWIFT SBININBB339, by RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant - Research at a Glance

rows.details: Deysarkar Centre of Petroleum and Energy Transition
Polymer - Crosslinker - Breaker System for High - Temperature Hydrofracturing Applications in Gandhar and Mumbai High Oil Fields (Project Code – C/PCGM)
12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 35,500 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post, Project Research Assistant - Research, with the following essential qualification options. Candidates with ITI may be considered only in exceptional cases, with prior approval and justification, and a skill test will be required. Knowledge of Computer applications, Secretarial experience for Technical and Ministerial. B.Tech in Petroleum Engineering is preferred, with CGPA>7.5. Experience in handling HTHP equipment and advanced Rheometer. Desired experience: minimum 2 years.

rows.essential_qualification: BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree; OR B.Sc./B.A./B. Com or equivalent degree with 2 years of relevant experience; OR 3-year Diploma with 5 years of relevant experience; OR, in exceptional cases, ITI (2-year course) in a trade with more than 8 years of relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 35,500 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice calls the post a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant - Research
content_sections.text: Apply online before 28 November 2026; the notice invites applications through online mode. Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form. The application fee is Rs. 0 for every category. The notice says a fee, where deposited, goes to State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302, account name IIT SRIC-OM Account, account no. 39502115210, IFSC SBIN0000202, SWIFT SBININBB339, by RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. A skill test is required in the exceptional case of an ITI candidate.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Research Assistant - Research posts are there at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Project Research Assistant - Research in the Deysarkar Centre of Petroleum and Energy Transition.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for this post?
faq.answer: BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree. Alternatively, B.Sc./B.A./B. Com with 2 years of relevant experience, or a 3-year Diploma with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 35,500 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. Transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.question: Q9. Can ITI holders apply?
faq.answer: Only in exceptional cases: ITI (2-year course) in a trade with more than 8 years of relevant experience, with prior approval and justification. A skill test will be required.

faq.question: Q10. Who is sponsoring the project?
faq.answer: The sponsoring agency is SNF Flopam India Pvt. Ltd, and the PI/Co-PI is Prof./Dr. Sandeep D Kulkarni.
